messages:
SRE-Bot: Incident detected — high tail latency (p95/p99) for hosted-api-eu-west-1 svc-inference-hosted. IncidentID: INC-20231208-447. Thresholds: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Dash: https://observability.redwood/inv/INC-447 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: seeing alerts, are we in a canary rollout? any recent deploys to eu-west-1?
Aj Patel: I'm primary oncall. No canary from infra in last 45m, last deploy was a config tweak at 02:10 UTC (not in path).
Devon R.: I'm secondary. Metrics show concurrent queue depth spike and longer KV cache misses around 02:05-02:20.
Maria Chen: ok primary/secondary confirmed. Quick checklist: 1) confirm if model fallback kicked 2) check pool utilization 3) scale if needed.
Aj Patel: looking at pool saturations — dedicated-pool-5 at 98% GPU utilization, autoscaler not kicking (policy min replicas pinned).
Devon R.: I can lift min replicas temporarily. Plan: bump min from 4 -> 8, rollover by scaling replicas. If that doesn't bring p99 down within 3m, we fallback to quantized-variant vq-1.
Aj Patel: doing scale now. Command: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-pool-5 --replicas=8```
SRE-Bot: Runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood/oncall/latency-spike — follow section "pool saturation" and "fallback variants".
Aj Patel: scaled, replicas increasing, starting warmup. Observability shows tail latency dropping from 1550ms -> 980ms at 02:12 UTC.
Maria Chen: good. Can you also enable prefix KV caching for high-frequency routes? Quick toggle in console: Routes > /v1/generate > enable prefix cache (30m ttl).
Devon R.: enabled prefix cache for /v1/generate, TTL 20m. Also purged problematic cold KV keys per runbook.
PagerDuty Bot: Alert on INC-20231208-447 updated: severity reduced to P2. If p99 < 800ms for 10m, auto-close.
Aj Patel: monitoring. If latency rebounds or error rate goes above 1%, escalate to infra-lead @LinaG. Current plan: keep elevated pool until traffic stabilizes and then gradually downscale.
Lina Gómez: pinged. Oncall infra lead checking capacity and scheduler logs, will confirm if any autoscaler bug.
Maria Chen: note for post-incident: autoscaler policy should not be pinned to < min where we expect burst capacity. Add a regression alert if min_replicas < 6 during business hours.
Devon R.: agreed. Also suggest adding a synthetic canary against quantized variant to detect quality regressions before auto-fallback.
Aj Patel: timeline so far: 02:05 alert -> 02:08 confirmed pool saturation -> 02:09 scaled -> 02:12 latency improved -> 02:20 prefix cache enabled -> 02:40 traffic normalized.
Maria Chen: closing criteria: p99 < 800ms and errors < 0.5% for 30m. If met, we'll run a short RCA and action items.
Lina Gómez: I captured scheduler logs and a temp patch to avoid autoscaler pinning; will open infra ticket INFRA-765 and assign.
Devon R.: handing off to morning shift, Aj primary remains on until 08:00 UTC handoff. Please escalate to me if anything reappears.
Aj Patel: noted, will keep monitoring and will escalate per paging rules: page infra-lead (P1) immediately if service error rate > 2% or p99 > 1500ms for 5m. Page product-ops if customers impacted (>= 5% requests failing).
Maria Chen: thanks team. I'll draft a short blameless summary for the incident channel and coordinate postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:
